{{Quote|GEONOSIS FORWARD CONTROL TO FLEET SUPPORT, ORD MANTELL.''"<br />"''PREPARE TO RECEIVE CASEVAC TRANSPORT. MED TRIAGE TEAM ESTIMATE SERIOUS INJURIES, TWELVE THOUSAND, REPEAT TWELVE THOUSAND. WALKING WOUNDED EIGHT THOUSAND, REPEAT EIGHT THOUSAND. ETA TEN HOURS.|Genonosis Forward Control after the First Battle of Geonosis|<ref name="RC:HC" />}}
'''Geonosis Forward Control''' was an element of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] active<ref name="RC:HC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]]<ref name="TERC" /> after the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|First Battle of Geonosis]], the first battle of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]]. In the aftermath of the battle, Geonosis Forward Control relayed casualty [[triage]] details to [[Fleet Support]] on<ref name="RC:HC" /> the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], which consisted of twelve thousand [[Trooper/Legends|troops]] with serious injuries and a further eight thousand walking wounded [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]]. Additionally, Geonosis Forward Control ordered Fleet Support to prepare to accommodate seventy-two thousand additional combat-ready troopers.<ref name="RC:HC" />

==Behind the scenes==
Geonosis Forward Control was mentioned in the [[2004]] novel ''[[Republic Commando: Hard Contact]]'', written by [[Karen Traviss]].<ref name="RC:HC" />
